about.title: About Avalon Insurance Agency
text: Avalon Insurance Agency represents many A-Rated insurance carriers which provide a wide range of insurance products such as Auto, Home, Personal Umbrellas, Boats, Motorcycles, Flood, and Commercial coverage for Property, General Liability, Auto, Workers Compensation, and many other products.

Avalon’s trained staff includes agents with experience writing policies for both Personal Lines policies and Commercial Lines policies. Avalon also has experienced Account Managers trained to handle any questions, change requests, claim situations or other matters you would like to discuss with them during our working hours.
Since its start in 2006 Avalon chooses insurance companies with strong financial strength and a range of products that will fit the needs of our customers.
